findings.text: rubric.tests and the checkpoint say the seven negative controls the section names are present and green, but the test file carries one control and the run log records one mutation; the other six are ordinary assertions, so the recorded evidence is overstated.
baseline_suite.command carries `<scratch>` placeholders instead of the absolute paths that ran, the shape the delivery contract refuses because promotion fills a receipt from this line.

the done_when asks that the test files importing reckon.evidence or reckon._store add no failure against the base, and both arms run only the new test file, leaving tests/test_edit_plan_append_evidence.py and tests/test_evidence_synthesis.py unmeasured.

`assert anchor in json.dumps(result)` compares the anchor the test passed in against a refusal message the code builds from that same anchor, so it holds for any refusal; the guard is carried by the `ok is False` on the line above.
